thread:
billing-bot: alert: ZetaCorp invoice 2026-04-ZETA-001 shows annual prepay of $600,000 and an early termination credit request for 2026-06-15. please advise deferral reversal vs refund accrual.
Maya: pinging finance 50. @Oliver any precedence on how we treat early term on annual prepay?
Oliver: default is to prorate unused service and either refund or issue credit depending on contract. need contract clause.
Sam: contract ID C-2026-045 attached in contract-store: https://contracts.internal/redwood/C-2026-045.pdf. clause 7.2: "customer eligible for pro rata refund of unused prepaid fees less termination fee 5% of remaining term."
Priya: ok so two pieces: (1) calculate unused portion of prepay (2) recognize termination fee as revenue now? or offset? per ASC 606, termination fee linked to a promised service? need to inspect performance obligations.
Oliver: termination fee looks like compensation for early exit, not for future service. we can recognize termination fee immediately as revenue if it's not refundable. the remaining prepaid amount should be reversed from Deferred Revenue to Refund Liability or Cash/AR depending on whether refund is paid.
Maya: month-end cut is 2026-04-30. customer requests refund run on 2026-06-20. can we book an accrual now?
Priya: yes, accrue refund liability at month-end for expected refundable amount. JE approach: initial prepay on invoicing (already booked): ```DR Cash 600,000
CR Deferred Revenue 600,000``` pro rata at month-end (assume service start 2026-04-01, termination 2026-06-15) unused months = mid-June so unused days = 15 days of June + July-November? Wait timeline check.
Sam: clarification: invoice covers 12 months from 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. termination 2026-06-15 => used period = 2026-04-01 through 2026-06-15 (75 days). unused = 290 days. unused amount = 600,000 * (290/365) = 477,671 (rounded). termination fee = remaining term balance * 5% = 23,883. net refundable = 477,671 - 23,883 = 453,788.
Oliver: accounting entries for month-end (2026-04-30) should reflect expected refund liability and recognize termination fee as revenue only when termination effective or when collectibility criteria met? legal sent termination notice today, effective 2026-06-15. conservative approach: record accrual for refund liability now but only recognize termination fee as revenue upon effective termination date. For month-end close we book: ```DR Deferred Revenue 477,671
CR Refund Liability 477,671``` and hold termination fee unrecognized until 6/15.
Priya: audit will want documentation of assumptions and calculation. please attach the refund calc sheet and memo. Sam can you upload calc to GCS and tick audit checklist.
Sam: uploaded calc and memo: gs://redwood-finance/close/1924561234-zeta-refund-calc.xlsx and notes doc gs://redwood-finance/close/memos/zeta-termination-memo.md
Maya: also need AR and treasury input for cash flow timing. @treasury-team FYI will there be any impact to cash forecast?
Oliver: treasury: expect cash outflow mid-June if refund approved. we'll leave a note in cash forecast.
Priya: for closepack include JE ref JE-2026-04-201 and attach contract and calc. I'll prepare the reversal entry template for 6/15 to then move Refund Liability -> Cash/AR when refunded.
Maya: thanks. small ask for product: add a checkbox on the customer termination form to indicate whether prepay should be refunded vs credited to other account. makes automation easier.
Sam: noted and opened product ticket PROD-1229.
billing-bot: month-end checklist updated 50 item "ZetaCorp prepay refund accrual" assigned to Priya at 1924561380.
